summary: Regression smoke after deploy-readiness CORS/CSRF env-driven config change in settings.py and uvicorn dep add in pyproject.toml. All 3 seeded role logins, owner core read endpoints, Django-layer CORS preflight, and frontend login->dashboard verified clean on preview URL.

minor.issue: Trailing-slash URL returns 404; only `/api/inbound/grns` (no trailing slash) resolves. Either acceptance criterion or inbound/urls.py route should be aligned (path('grns', ...) currently).

Cloudflare/k8s ingress overrides Django CORS headers with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` and `Access-Control-Allow-Headers: *` on public preview URL. Django itself echoes the preview origin and sets allow-credentials true correctly (verified via internal localhost:8001). Because the React frontend is served from the same origin as /api, the browser does not perform CORS preflight — login works. The settings.py change is functionally correct; the ingress override is environmental and not a regression.

action_items: No regression from the CORS/CSRF env-driven settings change or uvicorn dep add. App works end-to-end on preview URL.
Optional: decide whether `/api/inbound/grns/` (trailing slash) should be added as an alias in inbound/urls.py, or update API docs to reflect the slashless route.

Note (informational, not a defect): the public ingress rewrites CORS headers to `*`; if a non-Emergent external origin ever needs credentialed CORS via the preview URL, the ingress layer (not Django) would need configuration.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.py CORS regex list still safely covers preview hosts (`^https://.*\.preview\.emergentagent\.com$`) and localhost dev ports — login from preview origin still preflights successfully at the Django layer.
CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS default `https://*.emergentagent.com` correctly covers `pt-mapper.preview.emergentagent.com` (wildcard match) — verified login POST succeeds.
CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS additive env split correctly filters empty strings (`[o for o in ... if o]`) — no `[""]` poisoning when the env var is unset.
DJANGO_SECRET_KEY / DATABASE_URL / DJANGO_DEBUG / DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS use `os.environ[...]` (fail-fast). Good.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 covers deploy-readiness regression: env-driven CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS, CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS default 'https://*.emergentagent.com', and uvicorn dep. Reusable test: /app/app/backend/tests/test_iteration13_cors_config_regression.py. Note: CORS preflight assertions must hit http://localhost:8001 directly because the public ingress overrides CORS headers to `*`. Inbound list endpoint is `/api/inbound/grns` (no trailing slash).
rca of the issue: No defects introduced by the settings.py / pyproject.toml deploy-readiness changes. Two findings worth surfacing: (1) trailing-slash mismatch on /api/inbound/grns vs review-request URL — pre-existing route shape; (2) public ingress rewrites CORS headers — environmental, not a Django config issue.
